channel.title: Paste Media Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: Something We All Got finds cootie catcher bursting at the seams
item.description: The Toronto band’s second album is full off-axis instrumentals that whiz by you, as electric guitars fray and detune while live drum grooves take up arms against the programmed beats.

item.title: Ekko Astral share statement on split with Topshelf, drummer Miri Tyler
item.description: Jael Holzman and Liam Hughes shared an update with Paste on the recent events, specifically Washington City Paper’s report, which they’ve deemed to have been “reported inaccurately and irresponsibly.”

item.title: Border politics suffuse an exploitative romance in Dreams
item.description: Jessica Chastain and Isaac Hernández embody the provocation at the heart of Michel Franco's blunt U.S.-Mexico metaphor Dreams.

item.title: The teaser for Jane Schoenbrun's Teenage Sex And Death At Camp Miasma lives up to its title
item.description: Starring Hannah Einsbinder and Gillian Anderson, writer-director Jane Schoenbrun's new nightmare positions Videodrome alongside Friday The 13th.

item.title: WB pulls a Friendship and drops a Mortal Kombat II trailer
item.description: For Karl Urban's Johnny Cage, it's lights, camera, and a lot of action in the trailer for Mortal Kombat II.

item.title: Republican AGs firmly Team Paramount in warning letter about WB-Netflix deal
item.description: The Republican Party's ongoing effort to block Netflix's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery continues.

item.title: AMC to start saving its "best" movie seats for premium loyalty program members
item.description: Three years after abandoning a program for tiered movie seat prices, AMC is bringing it back as a "benefit" for paying subscribers.
